_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: ICAEW CFAB exam modules page (module list, 1.5-hour CBE format, 55% pass mark) plus the CFAB/Certificate-level study-resources pages for each of the six modules (Accounting, Assurance, Business Technology and Finance, Law, Management Information, Principles of Taxation) and the ICAEW Next Generation ACA/CFAB syllabus handbook (icaew.com), all fetched live 2026-09-27. UK tax figures for the Principles of Taxation module (personal allowance, income tax bands/rates, Class 1/Class 4 NIC thresholds and rates, VAT registration threshold and rates, corporation tax rates and marginal relief) are the 2026/27 UK tax year figures, fetched live from HMRC (gov.uk), the House of Commons Library, and current professional tax-rates publishers on 2026-09-27.
_items_source.version: Current live CFAB syllabus and exam-format pages (module list, format, pass mark) as published on icaew.com on 2026-09-27; UK tax rates/thresholds are the 2026/27 tax year figures, fetched live on the same date. Both should be rechecked periodically: ICAEW updates its syllabus/study guides roughly annually, and UK tax rates/thresholds change at least annually (usually from 6 April following a Budget/Autumn Statement).
_items_source.numbering: Ids use ICAEW's own CFAB syllabus numbering style for each module - a syllabus section number plus a lettered sub-point, e.g. ACC.1a, ASR.2c, BTF.3d, LAW.4a, MI.1e, TAX.3f - prefixed with a short module code (ACC=Accounting, ASR=Assurance, BTF=Business Technology and Finance, LAW=Law, MI=Management Information, TAX=Principles of Taxation) so ids are unique across the combined course.
